fidelityBoundary: Terminal Velocity automation/design scaffold; not an EV Classic fidelity claim without original runtime, decoded Classic resources, or manual/docs confirmation.

levo_merchant_first_hop.purpose: Merchant first-hop loop: buy a Levo commodity lot, accept a safe cargo job, jump, land, and complete delivery.

mission_runner_first_delivery.purpose: Mission-runner loop: reserve cargo, travel to destination, complete job, release reserved cargo, and receive pay.

route_planner_refuel_loop.purpose: Route-planner loop: spend fuel on a jump, detect insufficient fuel as a blocker, and refuel while landed.

low_fuel_jump_recovery.purpose: Low-fuel recovery loop: force empty fuel, block a route jump without changing systems, and refuel at the current landed port.

blocked_reason_curriculum.purpose: Safe blocker recognition: not landed, insufficient cargo, insufficient credits, invalid destination, and no deliverable job.

pirate_avoidance_escape_route.purpose: Pirate-avoidance loop: detect a symbolic pirate intercept, choose a linked safe-port jump, land, and verify combat remains unexecuted while preserving scaffold/source-boundary labels.

disposable_combat_placeholder.purpose: Combat/piracy guardrail scaffold only; records stop conditions without executing destructive tests.

intro_courier_mission_delivery.purpose: Intro courier mission loop: travel from Levo to Earth, accept the first courier mission, reserve mission cargo, travel to Luna, complete delivery, release cargo, receive reward, and apply story flags.

scan_intro_mission_offers.purpose: Mission-offer scan loop: travel to Earth, inspect landed mission offers by surface, and archive available mission ids before accepting a contract.

chapter_one_courier_chain.purpose: Chapter-one courier chain: complete the intro courier, frontier sample transfer, and return contract in one deterministic noncombat story loop.

alignment_choice_guardrail.purpose: Alignment branch guardrail: accept one mutually exclusive faction branch, then verify the incompatible branch is unavailable without mutating cargo or completing combat.

shift_click_multi_stop_route_queue.purpose: Map route-planner loop: Shift-click linked stops to build a green multi-hop route queue, then consume only the first leg on jump.

route_queue_invalid_stop_guardrail.purpose: Map route guardrail loop: preserve the current green route queue when a duplicate/current-system or unlinked stop is attempted from the route tail.
route_queue_invalid_stop_guardrail.surface: map route planning/Terminal Velocity guardrail scaffold

route_queue_clear_guardrail.purpose: Map route guardrail loop: clear a queued multi-stop route explicitly, then block jump until another destination is selected.
route_queue_clear_guardrail.surface: map route planning/Terminal Velocity guardrail scaffold

route_queue_clear_reselect_guardrail.purpose: Map route guardrail loop: after clearing a queued multi-stop route, accept a fresh route selection and jump only after that re-selection.
route_queue_clear_reselect_guardrail.surface: map route planning/Terminal Velocity guardrail scaffold

near_center_jump_block.purpose: Hyperspace distance guardrail: block a queued route jump while still near the system center, preserve system/fuel state, and label the behavior from original-runtime near-center failure evidence while exact distance remains pending.

mission_destination_route_hint.purpose: Mission objective route hint: after accepting an active courier contract, queue the contract destination as the next map route leg.
mission_destination_route_hint.surface: mission objective/map route guidance design scaffold

mission_abort_releases_reserved_cargo.purpose: Mission abort scaffold: abort an active courier contract without completion, release its reserved cargo, and keep source/oracle boundaries explicit pending Classic confirmation.

outfitter_ship_ladder_intro.purpose: Outfitter/ship-ladder intro: reach Earth, buy a cargo upgrade and weapon, then trade up to a larger ship from local manifest stock while preserving explicit scaffold/source-boundary labels.
